text:
Anya: Heads-up — we need to align on the per-route KPIs surface in Console. PM asked for p50/p95/p99, throughput, error rate, and a token-level latency breakdown per route. Can we sketch what we need to ship for next sprint?

Keith: +1. From runtime side we should expose: kernel_variant, batch_size, kv_cache_hit (per-request), and token_latency_bucket. Without those it's hard to correlate regressions to kernel selection or batching heuristics.

Sam: UX idea: top row = route selector + model variant dropdown. Middle row = KPI cards (p50/p95/p99 latency, rps, error %). Bottom = waterfall/token-level histogram + recent traces table. Route-level compare mode (side-by-side two routes) would help.

Maria: We already scrape token_latency_bucket and requests_total. Suggest PromQL examples to power cards:
```promql
# throughput per-route
sum(rate(requests_total{job="runtime"}[1m])) by (route)
# p95 token latency per-route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket{job="runtime"}[5m])) by (le, route))
```
We need a route label on the token buckets — confirm runtime will add if missing.

Keith: Runtime will add route and kernel_variant tags on token_latency_bucket. Also adding batch_size label on request spans. For KV cache: we'll emit kv_cache_hit{route, prefix_len_bucket}. That lets you chart hit ratio by prefix length.

Anya: Good — can we define prefix_len_bucket buckets? e.g., 0-32,33-128,129-512,512+? PM wants to know when long prefixes cause p95 regressions.

Keith: Those buckets look fine. We'll also instrument avg_keys_cached and cache_eviction_rate per pod. Quick profiling from a canary earlier: p95 tokens increased by ~3.2% after kernel v2 switch, correlated with kv_cache_hit drop from 87%→74% on chat-long route.

Sam: That's actionable. Dashboard should show a multi-series chart: p95 latency vs kv_cache_hit% vs median batch_size. Use dual axes or small multiples. Add anomaly flags when p95 worsens >5% week-over-week.

Maria: For error rate card use: (sum(rate(errors_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route)) * 100. Want to include 5xx vs 4xx breakdown.

Jordan-bot: perf-regression-alert: route="chat-long" p95 +3.2% after deploy 2026-03-01T09:12Z. Linked to kernel_variant=v2.

Anya: Can we get a sample query for kv hit ratio? I want a ready-to-use panel.

Keith: Sure:
```promql
# kv hit ratio per route
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{job="runtime"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total{job="runtime"}[5m])) by (route)
```
Also expose prefix_len_bucket so UX can subgroup.

Sam: UX note — for the token waterfall, we need per-token breakdown: model_compute, kernel_kernel_switch, kv_lookup, io, serialization. Are those labels available?

Keith: We'll surface token_phase labels on token_latency_* metrics: phase=(compute|kernel_switch|kv|io|serialize). Should be lightweight counters/histograms.

Maria: We'll add derived panels: token_phase stacked area to show where time is spent. And a table of recent traces where token_phase.kv spikes.

Ops-bot: deploy:dashboard-kpis/2026-03-02 queued. CI perf test must pass: p95 regression < 2% on canary.

Anya: OK, action items:
- Keith: add labels (route, kernel_variant, batch_size, prefix_len_bucket, token_phase) and kv metrics. (ETA: 1 week)
- Maria: build PromQL panels and wire up cards with thresholds + alerts. (ETA: 1 week)
- Sam: mockups for layout + compare mode + anomaly flags. (ETA: 3 days)
- Keith/SRE: add CI perf check for p95 < 2% regression.

Keith: noted. Will also emit histogram_quantile-ready buckets for token latency.

Sam: I'll drop a Figma link later and include a small mobile layout for Console.

Maria: One more: include per-route sample size card (tokens/sec and requests/sec) so p99 stats are interpretable.

Anya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap ticket and link to this thread. :thumbsup:

Jordan-bot: ticket updated: RD-INF-7425 — per-route KPI panels (linked to thread).
